text.title: Feedback Management Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure for applying feedback management end-to-end, with the six-step pipeline overview, the agent workflow, and the app store response strategy.

list.item: Step 1: Centralize — single source of truth (Canny, Productboard, Notion, or spreadsheet); auto-import from support + in-app
Step 2: Triage — type, topic, source, segment, sentiment per item; always preserve verbatim
Step 3: Aggregate — volume by category, trends over time, top requests by mention count
Step 4: Prioritize — connect to backlog items; weight by segment/ARR, not raw count
Step 5: Act — build (add to roadmap), won't do (document reason), need more info, already planned
Step 6: Close loop — email "you asked, we built" when feature ships; respond within 30 days of ship date

section.title: Agent workflow

list.item: triage agent (per item): outputs structured JSON — type, topic, sentiment, segment, severity, dedup_hash, suggested_backlog_link
weekly aggregator (per week): groups by topic + dedup_id, surfaces top requests with mention counts and segment breakdown
close-loop agent (on deploy): watches deploy pipeline, drafts "you asked, we built" emails for human approval before send

section.reference: Single-item triage: normalizes text, computes dedup hash, calls LLM with strict JSON schema, validates topic against taxonomy.

step.name: ingest
step.action: Pull from support / NPS / app-store / sales / social into ingest queue; preserve verbatim + source.
step.decision-gate: If a channel adapter fails > 24h, escalate before normalize step.

step.name: normalize
step.action: Map to canonical fields {source, date, user_id, segment, plan_tier, verbatim}; resolve user_id via CRM lookup.
step.decision-gate: If user_id resolution rate <80%, fix CRM linkage before triage.

step.name: classify
step.action: Run triage agent (haiku) over taxonomy v1; emit classification.taxonomy_path; reject items whose verbatim is too short to classify.
step.decision-gate: If classification confidence <0.6, route to human review queue.
Strip emails, phone numbers and account ids from the verbatim before any LLM call; raw PII may not leave the canonical store.

step.name: deduplicate
step.action: Group near-duplicates by embedding similarity (cosine >= 0.85) rather than full-text match, so paraphrases of one issue count once.
step.output: Deduplicated records with a dedup id per cluster.
step.decision-gate: Quarterly, sample 50 auto-classified items and have a human re-tag them; if agreement falls below 80%, update the prompt or the taxonomy before the next monthly review.

step.name: rank-monthly
step.action: Compute weight = segment_arr × retention_risk × frequency; produce top-10 themes with verbatim citations.
step.output: Top-10 themes ready for monthly review.
step.reference: Feedback table with category breakdown by month, top requests with segment and status.

step.name: dispose-and-close-loop
step.action: PM dispositions each (will-do / under-consideration / won't-do); will-do + under-consideration trigger close-loop email within 14 days.
step.decision-gate: If close_loop_sent_at not set within 14d, alert on dashboard.
step.reference: Close-loop response templates per disposition: feature shipped, not planned, more info needed.

list.item: 1-2 star reviews: respond within 24h, apologize, offer direct support channel, log in feedback system
3-4 star reviews: thank and ask what would make it 5 stars, log the gap
5 star reviews: thank and ask for referrals or testimonial
